Details: Demonstration workbook for Durgesh Tiwari's Data Scientist task.
All records are synthetic examples, not actual college or student records.
Student names are anonymized labels; no real contact details are included.
Use the Student_Data, Company_Data, Job_Postings, Applications, Placement_Drives, Offers, and Historical_Placements sheets.
Placement rates, application funnel, drive participation, company-wise selections, salary summaries, and unplaced student follow-up.
Illustrative records may not reconcile across every sheet. Validate joins and document assumptions before reporting.
Salary packages are illustrative annual packages in INR lakhs per annum (LPA).
